---
title: "National Partnerships"
---

ÇAHSPAR builds strong partnerships between researchers, public bodies, universities and civil society to develop effective solutions in working life and social policy across Türkiye. Partnerships are an important way of creating value and extending the reach of the association’s work.

## Our Partnership Approach

- Collaboration with academic institutions
- Strategic dialogue and project development with public bodies
- Joint action with civil society organisations
- Collaborative efforts to increase stakeholder participation

## Areas of Collaboration

- Coordination between institutions and joint project design
- Policy research addressing local and national needs
- Coordination of training, research and fieldwork
- Stakeholder partnerships for sustainable impact
